gamerule.minecraft.allow_entering_nether: Controls whether players are allowed to enter the Nether.
gamerule.minecraft.block_drops.descripti: Controls resource drops from blocks, including experience orbs.
gamerule.minecraft.block_explosion_drop_: In block interaction explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by block interactions are lost in the explosion.
gamerule.minecraft.ender_pearls_vanish_o: Thrown Ender Pearls vanish on death
Whether Ender Pearls thrown by a player vanish when that player dies.
gamerule.minecraft.entity_drops.descript: Controls drops from minecarts (including inventories), item frames, boats, etc.
Angered neutral mobs stop being angry when the targeted player dies nearby.
gamerule.minecraft.global_sound_events.d: When certain game events happen, like a boss spawning, the sound is heard everywhere.
gamerule.minecraft.lava_source_conversio: When flowing lava is surrounded on two sides by lava sources, it converts into a source.
gamerule.minecraft.limited_crafting.desc: If enabled, players will be able to craft only unlocked recipes.
gamerule.minecraft.locator_bar.descripti: When enabled, a bar is shown on the screen to indicate the direction of players.
gamerule.minecraft.max_block_modificatio: The number of blocks that can be changed at once by one command, such as fill or clone.
gamerule.minecraft.max_command_forks.des: Maximum number of contexts that can be used by commands like 'execute as'.
gamerule.minecraft.max_command_sequence_: Applies to command block chains and functions.
gamerule.minecraft.max_minecart_speed.de: Maximum default speed of a moving Minecart on land.
gamerule.minecraft.max_snow_accumulation: When it snows, layers of snow form on the ground up to at most this number of layers.
gamerule.minecraft.mob_drops.description: Controls resource drops from mobs, including experience orbs.
gamerule.minecraft.mob_explosion_drop_de: In mob explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by mobs are lost in the explosion.
gamerule.minecraft.players_nether_portal: Player's Nether Portal delay in creative mode
Time (in ticks) that a creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether Portal before changing dimensions.
Player's Nether Portal delay in non-creative mode
Time (in ticks) that a non-creative mode player needs to stand in a Nether Portal before changing dimensions.
gamerule.minecraft.players_sleeping_perc: The percentage of players who must be sleeping to skip the night.
gamerule.minecraft.projectiles_can_break: Controls whether impact projectiles will destroy blocks that are destructible by them.
gamerule.minecraft.pvp.description: Controls whether players are allowed to damage other players.
gamerule.minecraft.respawn_radius.descri: Controls the size of the area around the spawn point that players can spawn in.
gamerule.minecraft.spawn_mobs.descriptio: Some entities might have separate rules.
gamerule.minecraft.spread_fire_far_from_: Controls whether fire and lava should be able to tick further than 8 chunks away from any player.
gamerule.minecraft.spread_vines.descript: Controls whether the Vines block spreads randomly to adjacent blocks. Does not affect other types of vine blocks such as Weeping Vines, Twisting Vines, etc.
gamerule.minecraft.tnt_explodes: Allow TNT to be activated and to explode
gamerule.minecraft.tnt_explosion_drop_de: In TNT explosions, some blocks won't drop their loot
Some of the drops from blocks destroyed by explosions caused by TNT are lost in the explosion.
gamerule.minecraft.water_source_conversi: When flowing water is surrounded on two sides by water sources, it converts into a source.
